Priority Urgent matches red box heading; structure (dizziness AND or(...)) with severe-sudden AND (nausea/vomiting/eye/walk) is faithful. Minor: asymmetric and 'lying flat with leg swelling' qualifiers dropped.

summary: No rule exists for the page's two 'likely' diagnoses Orthostatic hypotension (with BP-drop criteria) and Anaemia (Hb <12 woman / <13 man), so the whole left branch of the flowchart is unencoded even though the BP measures exist. Positional vertigo and vestibular neuronitis rules contain an invented (no Collapse) OR-branch, positional vertigo tests its own diagnosis concept as evidence, and the 'onset >= 1 hours' threshold is invented. The red-box Urgent rule is otherwise faithful, apart from the dropped 'asymmetric' qualifier.
